$comment: Contract for the SubmitReview server-side command (AD-003, command-concurrency skill). Deployed by plugins/deploy/Register-SubmitReview.ps1. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SubmitReview
customApi.description: Checker submits their own Tax or AQS review instance (FR-010..FR-017). Enforces caller, transition, mandatory questions, optimistic concurrency and idempotency, writes an immutable Audit Event, and locks the review.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_reviewinstance to submit.

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version the client read, for optimistic concurrency. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay upserts the same Audit Event.

responseProperties.name: Status
responseProperties.description: The review status after the command (Submitted).

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
